notes.title: I SUPPOSE goes free to play!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Soon, I SUPPOSE will be going free to play in an effort to make it more accessible for anyone to play. I want as many people to enjoy the game as possible without any barriers to entry, and I hope anyone who wants to play this short story can find enjoyment within it! It was a very fun project to work on and it just feels right to make it free now that my skills in development have improved since releasing. Thank you to everyone who has already supported the game before this decision, it means the world to me.

The game should (hopefully) be free to play at the end of the month (31st May).

Thank you so much for the support,

Scott

notes.title: Launch Option Fix
notes.notes:
Hello!

A small change to launch configuration settings has been made which should hopefully make starting the game a little more streamlined by fixing the launch option popup, usually for the first time the game is played.

I will be paying attention to the state of the game and will likely make some other small changes and improvements here and there, based on community feedback.

Thanks for playing! :D
